VERSION 3.28.0.172
VERSION 3.29.1.0
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            AppLoadLibrary { id: ankiPureCliLibrary }
            Timer {
                interval: 500
                running: true
                repeat: true
                property string lastNonce: ""
                function readCommand() {
                    const request = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    request.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.ankimarkable-pure/launcher-command.json", false);
                    request.send();
                    try { return JSON.parse(request.responseText); } catch (error) { return {}; }
                }
                onTriggered: {
                    const command = readCommand();
                    if (!command.nonce || command.nonce === lastNonce) return;
                    lastNonce = command.nonce;
                    let ok = true;
                    let message = "";
                    if (command.action === "reload") {
                        ok = ankiPureCliLibrary.reloadList() > 0;
                        message = ok ? "Application list refreshed" : "Close AppLoad applications before updating";
                    } else if (command.action === "open") {
                        ok = false;
                        for (let app of ankiPureCliLibrary.applications) {
                            if (app.id === "ankimarkable-pure") {
                                AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication(app.id, [], {}, false);
                                ok = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        message = ok ? "Anki opened" : "Refresh the application list first";
                    } else {
                        ok = false;
                        message = "Unknown launcher action";
                    }
                    console.log("AnkiPureCLI:" + command.nonce + ":" + (ok ? "ok" : "error") + ":" + message);
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0
    TRAVERSE Background
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            AppLoadLibrary { id: ankiPureNotebookLibrary }
            function ankiNotebookId() {
                const request = new XMLHttpRequest();
                request.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.ankimarkable-pure/native-notes.json", false);
                request.send();
                try { return JSON.parse(request.responseText).book_id; } catch (error) { return null; }
            }
            function openAnkiNotebook(entry) {
                if (!entry || String(entry.id) !== ankiNotebookId()) return false;
                for (let app of ankiPureNotebookLibrary.applications) {
                    if (app.id === "ankimarkable-pure") {
                        AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication(app.id, [], {}, false);
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                return false;
            }
        }
        REBUILD openDocument_helper
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            INSERT STREAM / if (openAnkiNotebook(entry)) return; /
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
        LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.SidebarItem#filterMyFiles
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                id: openAnkiPure
                objectName: "openAnkiPure"
                text: "Anki"
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/my_files"
                enabled: true
                onClicked: {
                    root.hide();
                    AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication("ankimarkable-pure", [], {}, false);
                }
                Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            readonly property var ankiNavigationControls: [pageLabel, titleLabel, pageSliderBackground, pageSlider, pages]
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
